asr.full_text: Subscribe to our Technical Guruji channel And Click on the bell icon For the latest technology videos Friends, Samsung has launched a brand new phone from its Galaxy M series This Samsung Galaxy M31 Samsung calls it now a Mega Monster So today we will unbox the same Galaxy M31 Let's look at how this phone works Are there some some new features? What is the price of this Galaxy M31 and see what is new and different about this smartphone in the upcoming videos, we'll be launching a giveaway Namashkar Friends, My Name is Gaurav and you are watching Technical Guruji Let's begin Friends, I have here and a phone that I was going to give away to someone who was interested! This is the latest new smartphone of the Samsung Galaxy M series… the Galaxy M31 in a typical Samsung styling, where you can see lots of colorful elements in the front of the phone. A good set of branding words for the Galaxy M31 on the side. And here we have… the Black Black variant that comes with 128 gb internal storage however the price in a box is 17,499 Rs but this is not the right price I'll tell you in the video about the exact price of this phone for now, like and share the video I'll do the seal break see how is it hidden in the box below the But let's see how the phone is hidden inside the box, So at the bottom of the lid, is a section where we have Samsung branding and we have a SIM tray tool, a few documents as well. And we have hidden underneath under the plastic wrap the black in colour Galaxy M31 smartphone. talk about the specs in detail if we look down there we have here this Samsung Adaptive Fast Charging charger solution which comes with 15w output and with it this USB-A to USB-C cable Now if we quickly disconnect the phone lets talk about the device black is quite a lot but looks interesting we'll now connect and boot the phone For now, let's talk about phone's protection. The Black looks too much Black but still it looks pretty interesting. Now let's talk about its physical design and overall look. Power lock on right side, as well as volume rocker. Secondary microphones are on upper side. Left side is pretty clean except for the triple slot sim tray. Apart from that, we have a decent headphone jack, usb C port clean except for this triple slot SIM tray, besides it it is a lower section, a lovely head phone jack, USB C port primary microphone, and a speaker grille Now, let's talk about the design given behind the phone So, this design has been made from poly carbonate which looks really cool and quality is quite good and it comes with this completely black colour, along with another colour option that is blue the quality of this camera seems quite good and this comes in completely Black color and there is another color option available which is Blue but here what is special to us is that it comes along with a 64 megapixel quad rear camera where this is a 64 megapixel main camera and after that it's a 8 megapixel camera for Ultra-Wide angle shots then a 5 megapixel camera for Macro photos and then one for 5MP macros and then one for 5MP depth. Here's the 6 megapixels and ready flash on the side of the phone and then there's this rear-mounted fingerprint scanner and at the bottom is Samsung branding. in the front here It comes with a 6.4 inches Super AMOLED Infinity-U display where it is a Full HD plus Display and the screen quality that you all already know is quite good so here on the top there's a protection for the corner-glass. Guys here the Infinity-U Design has this 32 megapixel front-facing selfie camera which is great. Now lets go to the settings to get some details This is a 32MP front-facing selfie camera Which is quite an impressive feature Now lets quickly go deeper into settings to see more of details about this phone Right now this is streaming with One UI v2 Which is based on the latest Android 10 And it has Aux which is connected to Exynos 9611 2.3 Ghz Octa Core Processor Mali G72 MP3 with 10nm GPU Gaming performance is quite impressive in this phone. However, the storage of this phone is of around 3,600 mAh which is equivalent to nearly 6,000 mAh. As it is a 6Gb RAM option and it is available in 8GB RAM too which gives you decent performance for a premium smartphone. There's a 6000 mAh battery-powered which means its performance will be monstrous for a long time, other than that, there are many options that you know about the Samsung phones which means you'll be able to enjoy the dark modes Now if I talk about the camera there are many options available like photos, videos the camera option available here whether its a Photos, Videos or selfies and infact here you can use both in 4K which would be good for vlogging and if you click into the video option the picture you are watching right now I am showing up using the front & rear video are seeing are these photos taken from the front and rear cameras. these photos look nice from the front it is a wide angle, normal, selfie and macro shot You should comment on how you prefer the photos taken in the front and rear cameras and you will find the result of the analysis the biometric security system, Fingerprint scanner is very useful It is in the phone at rear And it will help you Unlock the phone Face unlock is worked very efficiently And you will unlock the phone with it Without any problems And this is the story of the Samsung galaxy smartphone where the main highlight of this device is its 64 Megapixel Quad camera and 6,000 mAh, huge battery and a Super AMOLED Infinity U display which provides a good immersive experience and the processor is Exynos 9611 Octa score And now if we talk about the price of this phone here, This is it's base variant, which can be found for Rs 6GB RAM and 64GB storage for Rs 14,999 and the 6GB RAM 128GB storage variant is available for Rs 15,999 on Amazon now! So this is the story that comes from Samsung about the Galaxy M31 I'm definitely going to bring out some other surprises if you're one of them then do hit to like, share and comment let us know what do you think about the Galaxy M31 I will see you soon with another awesome video this is all friends, thank you for watching I hope you liked the video Don't forget to comment below if you have any suggestion do like and share the video and subscribe to the channel as I always bring such kind of videos that's it for now in such a way Jai Hind Vande Matram
